_PORT_TODO_secrets: ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection carries the sa User Id and Password verbatim from Web.config (local development credentials). Move them to user secrets / environment variables / AWS Secrets Manager before production.
_PORT_TODO_connectionString: ConnectionStrings:DefaultConnection already sets TrustServerCertificate=true, so it keeps working with Microsoft.Data.SqlClient's Encrypt=True default against a server without a trusted certificate; install a trusted SQL Server certificate and drop TrustServerCertificate before production. The providerName System.Data.SqlClient was dropped; EF Core uses UseSqlServer in Program.cs.
_PORT_TODO_requestLimits: Web.config httpRuntime maxRequestLength=512000 KB and IIS requestLimits maxAllowedContentLength=524288000 bytes are carried over as Kestrel:Limits:MaxRequestBodySize (524288000 bytes). Program.cs must also raise FormOptions.MultipartBodyLengthLimit to the same value and the SignalR hub MaximumReceiveMessageSize for InputFile uploads (Storage.MaxFilesPerUpload x Storage.MaxFileSizeMegabytes). httpRuntime executionTimeout=600 has no Kestrel equivalent; the upload/summarize flow is async instead.
_PORT_TODO_systemWeb: customErrors (mode=RemoteOnly, defaultRedirect=~/ErrorPage.aspx, 404 -> ~/ErrorPage.aspx?code=404) is replaced in Program.cs by UseExceptionHandler plus UseStatusCodePagesWithReExecute targeting the ported ErrorPage component; Web.Release.config set customErrors mode=On, which corresponds to the non-Development environment branch. compilation debug, pages controlRenderingCompatibilityVersion/clientIDMode and httpRuntime have no ASP.NET Core equivalent and were dropped.
_PORT_TODO_systemWebServer: defaultDocument Default.aspx is replaced by the Components/Pages/Default.razor route "/". requestFiltering requestLimits is covered by Kestrel:Limits:MaxRequestBodySize; if the app is hosted behind IIS, publish a web.config containing only <system.webServer> with requestLimits maxAllowedContentLength=524288000.
_PORT_TODO_entityFramework: The EF6 <entityFramework> section (SqlConnectionFactory, System.Data.SqlClient SqlProviderServices) is replaced by AddDbContext<DocumentDbContext>(o => o.UseSqlServer(...)) in Program.cs; the schema still comes from App_Data/Schema.sql via DatabaseInitializer.EnsureSchema.
_PORT_TODO_environments: Web.Debug.config contains no transforms and Web.Release.config only changes <system.web> host settings (compilation debug, customErrors mode), so no appsettings.Development.json / appsettings.Production.json values were needed. Set ASPNETCORE_ENVIRONMENT=Production for release deployments.
_PORT_TODO_runtime: The <runtime><assemblyBinding> redirects (Newtonsoft.Json, System.Buffers, System.Memory, System.Numerics.Vectors, System.Runtime.CompilerServices.Unsafe, Microsoft.Bcl.HashCode) were dropped; .NET resolves package versions without binding redirects.
